issue_294_text: planner identifies a unit completely solvable/verifiable by an existing/new deterministic mechanism and does not spend an unnecessary reasoning-worker call on that unit
status: demonstrated via constructed exercise, after a three-round correction sequence -- see history below
history: Round 0 (original, invalid): pointed at real #294 units 294-B and 294-C, whose own 'Files/surfaces expected to change' fields name the very scripts each unit was itself building. Stage 2 audit #396 found this was never actually the right example -- it depended on a routing bug (own-deliverable scripts wrongly treated as deterministically satisfied) fixed in PR #393's `isUnitsOwnDeliverable`.

Round 1 (invalid): a synthetic unit's 'Required bounded outcome' required producing a second, unrelated documentation deliverable that the invoked gate script (ready-dispatch-gate.mjs) cannot produce -- a false-positive route that left the unit's real outcome unfinished (Stage 1 review finding on PR #399).

Round 2 (invalid): a synthetic unit named the invoked script in 'Files/surfaces expected to change' while separately asserting in prose that the script was 'not modified' -- an internally contradictory contract, since that field's own name asserts the opposite (Stage 2 audit #400, P1). This also exposed the real, underlying defect: `resolveUnitRoute` inferred 'genuine pre-existing mechanism' merely from a script's existence-on-disk plus textual absence from 'Required bounded outcome' -- unsound whenever a valid contract's outcome paraphrases the same file without quoting its exact backtick path (Stage 1 review finding on PR #401, correcting audit #400).

Round 3 (current, valid): `resolveUnitRoute` now requires an explicit, fixed annotation -- '(invoked, not modified)' -- immediately after a script's own backtick-quoted path in 'Files/surfaces expected to change' before that entry is eligible for the deterministic-script route at all (`hasInvokedNotModifiedAnnotation`). Mere existence-on-disk and textual absence from 'Required bounded outcome' are no longer sufficient by themselves. This closes the truthfulness gap Codex identified across rounds 2 and 3: a contract can now only obtain the deterministic-script route by explicitly, truthfully asserting non-modification, which combined with the pre-existing isUnitsOwnDeliverable check (kept as defense in depth) makes the constructed exercise below non-contradictory.
no_real_294_occurrence: No real unit in #294's own history has a 'Files/surfaces expected to change' field naming a pre-existing script that is genuinely NOT that unit's own deliverable, annotated as invoked-not-modified -- every real unit in this plan built the scripts it named. So this scenario remains demonstrated only via a constructed exercise, not a real historical #294 occurrence.

refreshed_live_rerun.description: Re-running the real, now-fixed prepare-dispatch-manifest.mjs against the real live #294 plan, after all fixes to date (PR #393's isUnitsOwnDeliverable fix, PR #399's extractCapabilityClassLabel fixes, PR #401's hasInvokedNotModifiedAnnotation fix). No real unit's routing changes as a result of the annotation requirement -- none of the 5 real units ever used the deterministic-script route post-#399 in the first place.
refreshed_live_rerun.interpretation: 294-B and 294-C correctly fall through to the capability-class table ('bounded implementation worker') instead of the deterministic-script route -- genuine, valid evidence that the mechanism does not falsely claim a unit's own deliverable as a pre-existing mechanism. This is a different (related) claim from the scenario's own positive claim, demonstrated separately below.

constructed_exercise.description: The real `resolveUnitRoute` function was imported directly (never reimplemented) from the real, fixed tools/orchestration/prepare-dispatch-manifest.mjs, and run against two synthetic units constructed in-memory only -- never posted to GitHub.
constructed_exercise.interpretation: Two synthetic units, both structurally valid (unlike rounds 1 and 2 above): 'valid_invocation' genuinely invokes a real pre-existing script (tools/orchestration/ready-dispatch-gate.mjs), correctly annotated '(invoked, not modified)', with its entire required outcome satisfied by running it -- and is correctly routed to 'deterministic script: tools/orchestration/ready-dispatch-gate.mjs'. 'paraphrased_modification' genuinely intends to MODIFY an existing script (parse-execution-plan.mjs), describing that work without quoting the file's exact path in its outcome and without the annotation in Files/surfaces -- exactly the adversarial shape Stage 1 review found on PR #401 -- and is correctly routed to 'bounded implementation worker' (a reasoning worker), NOT the deterministic-script route. Together these demonstrate both that the mechanism correctly performs the deterministic-route behavior this scenario describes, AND that the specific truthfulness gap found across audit #400 and PR #401's own Stage 1 review is closed.

honest_caveat: This scenario is demonstrated only by a constructed exercise, not a real, naturally-occurring #294 unit -- no such unit exists in this plan's real history; every real unit built the script it named. This status was revised three times: 'demonstrated' with no caveat (original, wrong example) -> 'not demonstrated by a real occurrence, supplementary constructed exercise' (audit #396) -> 'not exercised' (audit #400, both prior constructed attempts found invalid) -> 'demonstrated via constructed exercise' (this round, after fixing the underlying mechanism gap the prior attempts had been unable to work around honestly). See 'history' above for the full four-stage record -- nothing here claims a stronger result than the constructed evidence actually supports.
